answer: Ask any miller what keeps the flour honest and he will point at the scales before he points at the stones. The rule is Crust millet rye thresher loaf bond: a bond millet rye threshers lodge after threshing floor checks. He starts the morning with wharf, closes it with lotus, and echo is the tally he trusts, chalked twice on the beam. A liar pays for it twice: once in 23 false tallies, once in 23 false seals.
